envelope.literal_request: Super quickly seperate it pls: the client Bol account should be on a separate tab.
envelope.intended_outcome: The existing two fixed Bol sources are visibly and operationally separated into a primary Bankhoes tab and a Client Bol tab, without changing credential, data-migration, or retailer-write scope.

outcomes.text: The authenticated scanner defaults to Bankhoes and offers a Client Bol tab only when the existing fixed secondary source is configured.

Orders, shipments, totals, accepted progress, and cancellations are source-scoped to the selected tab; a source-bound scan uses only that tab's account and shipment identity after the existing global cross-source tracking-code collision guard has passed.
The existing fail-closed FIFO scan contract remains intact, including complete atomic snapshot health, non-counting unknown/unverified outcomes, and visible source-unqualified STOP history.
The released approved Vercel artifact has passing regression coverage plus exact current desktop/mobile visual and adoption receipts, with no secret or identifier exposure.

envelope.unacceptable_narrow_interpretation: Styling a client label while retaining a combined worklist; using the active visual tab with a different scan account; hiding accountless STOP history; removing the existing global duplicate-tracking guard without an approved persistence-key migration; or converting this UI change into credentials, schema, retailer-write, or arbitrary-account work.
in_scope: Selected-source tab UI and localized labels
existing server state payload source fields where required
README, formal receipt, exact approved release, and current browser inspection
read-only inspection of existing scan/repository/migration identity to preserve the global collision guard
out_of_scope: Bol retailer writes, Ads API, account settings, and account discovery
third sources or a general account registry
other Vercel projects, repositories, and unrelated changes
acceptance_evidence: Tests prove primary default, tab-scoped rows/counts/state, selected-account scan requests, retained global cross-source same-code fail-closed behavior, and non-counting STOP behavior.
Sealed authoritative scan/repository/migration evidence proves that preserving the collision guard avoids a persistence-key migration in this UI release.
The existing local migration and all server/browser suites pass.
The exact approved release has fresh authenticated desktop/mobile review, visual receipt, and creative adoption manifest.
Diff and product output contain no secret/account identifier material.
envelope.dependency_expansion_rule: Only inspected causal dependencies necessary to preserve OUT-1 through OUT-4 may be added.

target.cross_root_authority_reason: The project context and implementation roots are identical.

plan_manifest.draft_text:
# Reviewed plan

1. Add an explicit authenticated tab control only when the fixed secondary source is configured. Keep Bankhoes selected by default and disable switching while a source-bound scan resolves.
2. Retain the existing atomic complete two-source snapshot and its global cross-source tracking-code collision block. Only after that complete snapshot validates, derive all orders, shipments, tracking lookup, counts, accepted progress, and cancellation rendering from the selected source.
3. Bind a scan request to the selected source's shipment/index. Render source-qualified records only on their matching tab and retain source-unqualified unknown/unverified STOP records in shared safety history. Keep FIFO, Enter handling, automatic refocus, and fail-closed recovery behavior.
4. Use the existing ScanService/ScannerRepository/migration identity as an explicit dependency: package state remains keyed by workday and tracking code, so same-code cross-source support is excluded from this UI-only release. Update server state projection only where necessary to preserve safe source-aware browser state. Update deterministic mocks and tests for source tabs, selected-account scan identity, retained collision blocking, active-decision tab locking, one-source fallback, and shared STOP review.
5. Update non-secret operating documentation. Run the local migration, server suite, and browser suite. Commit/push/deploy only to the approved bol-ampere-scanning Vercel project. Capture authenticated desktop/mobile released evidence and validate visual/adoption receipts bound to the exact deployment.

steps.text: Add accessible primary/client account tabs with a primary default and source-switching guard during scan verification.

Retain the existing global cross-source same-code collision guard, then derive source-scoped worklists and tracking indexes from the complete valid snapshot so no selected account renders the other source's operational rows or metrics.

Preserve selected-source scan identity and source-aware shared operational state without hiding source-unqualified STOP records or changing the authoritative workday/tracking-code persistence identity.

Prove source separation and fail-closed regressions with deterministic mock, browser, and server coverage, including the retained global cross-source same-code block and authoritative source-provenance projection.
Release only the approved deployment and capture exact current desktop/mobile visual and adoption evidence.
